classification_meanings.UNRUN: Mapped checks remain unrun after fail-fast. This alone establishes neither missing implementation nor product failure. Existing checks are candidates for separately authorized applicable verification.

programme_status: OPEN: integration, applicability-aware retained learning with measured avoided work, and the full original acceptance scope are unfinished.
excluded_claims: No general useful learning, adaptive convergence or neural-model reproduction is established by this release.
No semantic Origami folding integration or model-activation/circuit mechanistic interpretability is established.
No automatic repair, arbitrary tool execution, private-policy inheritance, cloud account setup or service startup on installation.
Frozen experiments 025/026 and development archives are provenance, not supported production capabilities.

retained_negative_findings.finding: All six paired engineering outcomes tied. Context integration did not demonstrate improved task outcomes; retaining/retrieving context alone is not useful learning.
Fixed lexical rules performed better for the tested task family. FAILED_CPU_LIMIT is preserved as a distinct supervisor/execution finding; it does not explain away the selector result.
NO_ADOPTION is retained. Startup-only benefits do not establish a total-cost advantage over strong warm/factor-aware classical baselines.
Keep raw storage for the tested group and no full-proposer deployment. Development data exposed during work are not held-out evidence.
